## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive (Sector Strength). Confirmation: strong sector breadth vs. mixed leadership (4/5 top performers concentrated in Communication & Tech) and a multi-stock divergence among large-cap Tech (MSFT, AMZN, META showing 1W/1M mismatch while NVDA/GOOGL remain BELOW TREND), so no clear directional conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +10.49%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +11.84%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +18.49%). Communication strong: NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%), TTWO RECOVERY (1W: +9.35% | 1M: -10.61%). Technology showing short-term strength but mixed monthly: INTU RECOVERY (1W: +16.55% | 1M: -16.68%), NOW RECOVERY (1W: +8.55% | 1M: -6.26%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples lagging: EL BELOW TREND (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -12.76%), MNST CORRECTION (1W: -4.29% | 1M: +1.27%). Consumer Discretionary soft: LOW BELOW TREND (1W: -6.27% | 1M: -3.55%), BKNG RECOVERY (1W: +7.98% | 1M: -18.26%). Materials mixed with pockets of CORRECTION (PPG CORRECTION: 1W: -4.91% | 1M: +2.90%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%), INTU RECOVERY (1W: +16.55% | 1M: -16.68%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +13.81%), PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +11.16% | 1M: -4.41%), TTWO RECOVERY (1W: +9.35% | 1M: -10.61%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 from Communication & Technology) — concentration risk.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: EL BELOW TREND (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -12.76%), LOW BELOW TREND (1W: -6.27% | 1M: -3.55%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -6.92%), TXN BELOW TREND (1W: -4.57% | 1M: -4.18%). Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech and select Consumer Staples.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +27.72%), INTU (1W: +16.55%), CEG (1W: +11.35%), PLTR (1W: +11.16%), TTWO (1W: +9.35%). Major divergence present — multiple large-cap names (MSFT, AMZN, META, AAPL) show 1W ≠ 1M patterns, so this is tactical momentum not broad-confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed: Tech is positive on the week but still negative on the month (1W strength, 1M weakness). AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -0.55% | 1M: +2.59%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +3.66% | 1M: -7.85%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%) — watch for leadership bifurcation between cap-weight leaders and episodic winners.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Flat-to-mixed: Financials small weekly gain but negative month (JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -2.89%), V RECOVERY (1W: +4.56% | 1M: -3.20%), MA RECOVERY (1W: +5.03% | 1M: -4.18%)). Breadth inside Financials is mixed; not a clean risk-on signal.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive pockets showing strength: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +9.94%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +0.90%), but LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.83% | 1M: -0.44%) highlights intra-sector dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Energy and Utilities leaders and high-conviction Communication/AI plays, reduce exposure to soft Consumer Staples and the weakest large-cap Tech (NVDA, GOOGL) until monthly trends confirm. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — treat active positions as tactical given leadership concentration and divergence.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.72% | 1M: +16.75%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +18.49%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +9.94%). BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.21%), EL BELOW TREND (1W: -11.07% | 1M: -12.76%), TXN BELOW TREND (1W: -4.57% | 1M: -4.18%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.67% | 1M: +14.28%) and Communication (1W: +3.32% | 1M: +8.03%) — watch follow-through. BEARISH: Consumer Staples and Consumer Discretionary (both negative on the week) — watch for further weakness and earnings/news sensitivity.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: continued failure to reclaim recent 1W range would confirm BELOW TREND continuation and widen tech sell signal. NFLX: sustain above this week’s gap would reinforce ABOVE TREND momentum. JNJ/UNH: holds above monthly support would cement defensive leadership; EL/LOW breakdowns below recent lows would accelerate sector pressure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ABT (+80): Abbott FDA approval for heart-failure device — cross-ref with sector strength (Healthcare showing weekly gains) suggests confirmation for device names, monitor price action. PEP (+75): buyback and price cuts headline — Consumer Staples news but EL weakness offsets sector; watch for relative performance. SHOP (+75): AI commerce pivot and buyback headline — sentiment bullish vs. Tech’s mixed monthly trend, treat as tactical until 1M turns positive.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
MSFT (-40): Richtech lawsuit headlines — MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +3.66% | 1M: -7.85%) shows divergence between news and short-term price, monitor for follow-through. F (-50): recall headline — Ford at risk for further downside given macro travel/auto sensitivity. FDX (-45): tariff lawsuits — Industrials name to watch as headline risk could pressure the sector despite mixed weekly breadth.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style; Growth and Value signals both present but no decisive tilt. Energy and Communication names are showing relative strength (XOM ABOVE TREND, NFLX ABOVE TREND) while large-cap Tech is bifurcated (MSFT RECOVERY, NVDA BELOW TREND). Key risk: leadership concentration and multi-stock 1W/1M divergences — watch for trend confirmation before expanding beta exposure.
